READ THE ROOM.

TREMØC is a New York-based DJ with a feel for the room and a love of groove.

He lets the early hours breathe, then builds the energy as the floor fills up. He knows when to stay with a sound and when to take the night somewhere new.

New York is home. The dancefloor is everywhere.

BUILT FOR
THE NIGHT.

Mexican by origin, a New Yorker for the last ten years — TREMØC learned the city's rooms from the inside out.

His sets run on a refined ear and an instinct for reading a room — easing out of a slow, low-lit start and building toward the peak of the night, crossing genres without ever losing the thread. The result feels effortless, a little unpredictable, and never quite like anyone else's.

This is the first chapter — and it's only getting started.
